    # Initialize the quota with infinity for each resource type
    cloud_quota = ResourceLimits(instances=float('inf'), memory=float('inf'), cpu=float('inf'))
    
    # Calculate the total usage from other providers
    other_endpoint_usage = sum(self.api.nodes_cache.getQuota(other_provider) for other_provider in self.api.providers if other_provider != provider)
    
    # Get the usage for the current provider
    this_provider_usage = self.api.nodes_cache.getQuota(provider)
    
    # Calculate the effective quota by subtracting both other endpoint usage and this provider's usage
    effective_quota = cloud_quota - other_endpoint_usage - this_provider_usage
    
    return effective_quota
